On OnePlus, enter *#899# in the dialer if supported by your firmware. Record the exact RPMB / SOTER result. To check for interference, disable the built-in TEE, reboot manually and repeat the same test. External TEE modules must also be disabled. If the error remains, check official updates for your exact model or ask authorized support to check provisioning. Do not erase persist, secure storage or RPMB. A software keybox cannot reprovision these hardware keys.
This changes the built-in TEE switch. Existing injection may remain until you reboot. Previously disabled external engines may become available again. It does not repair or erase hardware keys.
Built-in TEE disabled. Disable external engines too, then reboot manually and repeat the engineering check. You can re-enable the built-in TEE in Settings.
Could not change the switch. Check root access.
